contributionSummary: Exposes credential-authenticated member-directory routes with bounded filtering, pagination, rate limiting, and safe errors.

publicNote.description: Arbiter now includes a working member-directory API for approved Even Legion tools. It provides current division memberships, merit totals, and merit ranks for individual members or filtered groups, while read-only access controls and usage limits protect Arbiter from unauthorized or excessive use.
